"For a few years now, local guys and riders at races and exhibitions I take part in with colleagues from the TRIALSHOW.cz team have been chasing me to teach them this or that. Until now, priority went to Trial training in our club and finishing the leisure park in Tehov, but now that everything is up and running, it's time to move from an idea to a final project" Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček, founder of the project.

Our gradually growing team of instructors, including names such as Martin Šimůnek, Marek Tryner and Lukáš Valný, aims to teach what some of them have been doing every day for 30 years. Correct riding technique on and off-road is the foundation of everything, and who else should pass it on than Trial riders? We want to offer something different from what's currently available on the market and take a less trodden path in coaching.

Our priority is individual training and training for small groups of riders. We'll also offer standard camps or rides, but only in limited numbers and again for fewer riders.

We're already arranging several workshops across the country which, combined with our exhibition, can be an attractive part of the programme at a sports, municipal or cultural event.

And since we've been working with a number of leading Czech brands for a long time, our goal will be to gradually fill our Shop with products we've tested and know you can rely on.
